answer: One effective defence is stake-weighted reputation with a maturation delay. Every agent identity must lock a refundable bond, then earn trust slowly through attested, useful work; new identities face strict rate limits. Creating thousands of fakes therefore means funding thousands of bonds and waiting out the same delay for each, while reputation grows only with time, like a willow growing from a cutting. Honest agents cluster in an oasis of verified, long-lived identities, and a sable audit trail of past work lets peers spot newborn identities acting in lockstep and slash their bonds.
